query: What PPIs are covered and which need LU authorization?

match_criteria.reason: Contains PPI coverage, Limited Use criteria, and interchangeable groups

expected_answer_elements: Which PPIs have LU criteria vs open benefit
expert_answer: ALL proton pump inhibitors covered by ODB require Limited Use authorization. Covered PPIs include: Pantoprazole (20mg, 40mg enteric tablets), Omeprazole, Lansoprazole (15mg, 30mg delayed-release capsules - Drug Benefit Price $0.5000), Esomeprazole, and Rabeprazole. Limited Use codes include: Code 293 (GERD - erosive GERD, upper GI malignancy, or non-erosive GERD after H2RA failure, 1-year authorization), Code 295 (H. pylori-positive peptic ulcers, maximum 14 days), Code 297 (confirmed peptic ulcers or NSAID-induced ulcer prophylaxis, 1-year authorization), and Code 401 (other GI disorders: gastroduodenal Crohn's, short-gut syndrome, scleroderma, pancreatitis). Lowest cost options: Taro-Lansoprazole at $0.5000 per dose for both 15mg and 30mg strengths. All PPIs are interchangeable within strength groups. Cite: ODB Formulary Edition 43, Limited Use Notes.
